Hi Dana — great to hear the demo went well. Attaching the vendor packet and W-9 (PDFs) plus a short pricing/options CSV.

High level on payment routes and tradeoffs: 

- Purchase Order (PO) / Invoice (Net 30 by default): preferred for larger, long-term contracts. Requires a signed MSA + PO number. Typical procurement processing time: 5–15 business days once docs are submitted.
- Corporate card: fastest (immediate provisioning) but best for smaller initial commitments or POC usage capped to a card limit.
- Marketplace (AWS/GCP): available for customers who prefer cloud marketplace billing. Marketplace listing can add ~2–6 weeks for procurement/finance alignment and platform entitlements.
- Wire/ACH: accepted; we provide banking details in the vendor packet. Please include remittance instructions on any invoices.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Decide preferred payment path (PO vs card vs marketplace). 2) If PO, send the vendor portal invite link + preferred billing contact and PO number when available. 3) If marketplace, tell us which marketplace so we can confirm listing/terms.

We can also provision a short-term sandbox license once the vendor packet is complete while the PO is routed.

Attachments: Vendor_Packet_Redwood.pdf, Redwood_W-9.pdf, Pricing_Options_Table.csv

Best,

Kimberly Park

Thanks Dana — answers below and a proposed immediate next steps checklist.

1) Invoicing/Entity: Yes, we can invoice to "Acme Health Network, Inc.". Please include your PO number on the invoice; remittance to the bank in the attached packet is fine.
2) Net terms: Our standard is Net 30; for larger SOWs we are open to Net 45 subject to approval. If Net 45 is required we typically escalate to finance and can confirm within 3–5 business days.
3) Marketplace entitlements: Marketplace purchases provide equivalent hosted entitlements but there are some minor differences in billing and support routing (we'll provide the marketplace SKU mappings). SLA terms are equivalent once entitlements are applied.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
- You: confirm preferred payment path (PO / card / marketplace) and provide billing contact + PO number if available.
- We (Redwood): upload vendor packet to your portal and send a DocuSign quote for signature. Once signed / PO provided we can provision sandbox access and schedule onboarding.
